mapper.select: SELECT id, model_id, sub_menu_type, title, content_body, meta_json FROM model_contents WHERE model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY CASE sub_menu_type WHEN 'OVERVIEW' THEN 1 WHEN 'USAGE' THEN 2 WHEN 'PROS_CONS' THEN 3 WHEN 'BENCHMARKS' THEN 4 WHEN 'LINKS' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_contents (model_id, sub_menu_type, title, content_body, meta_json) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{subMenuType}, #{title}, #{contentBody}, #{metaJson})
